items.en: Excuse me, where is the station?
I am looking for a flat.
Could I get the check, please?
We would like to pay together.
Is this the queue for boarding?

items.tr: "Boleh" nazik bir istekte fiilden önce, cümlenin en başına gelir.
items.en: "Boleh" (may/can) goes at the very start of a polite request, before the verb.
items.context: Boleh minta nomor WhatsApp-mu? / ✗ Minta boleh nomor WhatsApp-mu?

items.en: You're meeting someone new and want to break the ice.
You want to know their name.
They ask for your name back.
You want to stay in touch.
Hi, let me introduce myself, I'm Budi.
What do you do for work?
Can I get your WhatsApp number?

items.tr: Satıcıya hitap ederken "kamu" yerine "Bu" (hanımefendi) veya "Pak" (beyefendi) kullanılır — saygı ifade eder.
items.en: Address a shopkeeper with "Bu" (ma'am) or "Pak" (sir) instead of "kamu" (you) — it shows respect.
items.context: Ini berapa, Bu? / ✗ Ini berapa, kamu?

items.en: A clerk asks if you need help.
You're pointing at an item's price.
You want to test the fit.
You're trying to bargain a little.
You think the price is high.
You've decided to buy it after all.
Do you have a smaller size?
Can you lower the price, ma'am?

items.tr: "Setengah" (yarım) ile saat söylenirken bir sonraki saat kullanılır: "setengah empat" saat 3:30 demektir, 4:30 değil.
items.en: With "setengah" (half), Indonesian names the NEXT hour: "setengah empat" (half four) means 3:30, not 4:30.
items.context: Sekarang jam setengah empat. / ✗ Sekarang jam empat setengah.

items.en: The clerk tells you the price.
You're planning to meet a friend.
I'll get there in ten minutes.

items.tr: İyelik genelde ayrı bir kelime değil, isme eklenen "-ku/-mu/-nya" (benim/senin/onun) ekiyle gösterilir.
items.en: Possession is usually shown by attaching "-ku/-mu/-nya" (my/your/his-her) to the noun, not a separate word.
items.context: Ibuku dokter. / ✗ Ibu punya saya dokter.
Saya punya dua adik laki-laki dan satu kakak perempuan.

items.en: They ask what your mother does.
You want to know a friend's kid's age.
They ask where your parents live.
items.context: Orang tua saya tinggal di Bandung.

items.target: Saya punya dua adik laki-laki dan satu kakak perempuan.
items.tr: İki küçük erkek kardeşim ve bir büyük kız kardeşim var.
items.en: I have two younger brothers and one older sister.
She really loves her little sibling.

items.target: Orang tua saya tinggal di Bandung.

items.tr: Hava durumu cümlelerinde İngilizce'deki "it" gibi bir özne yoktur; "lagi" sürmekte olan bir durumu gösterir.
items.en: Weather sentences have no dummy subject like English "it"; "lagi" marks something happening right now.
items.context: Lagi hujan nih. / ✗ Itu lagi hujan nih.

items.en: Your friend is leaving the house.
You wake up and check the window.
You're talking about your favorite weather.
Bring an umbrella, looks like it might rain.
Is the wind really strong today?

items.tr: Bir ulaşım aracına binmek için doğrudan "naik" + araç kullanılır, İngilizce'deki "by" gibi bir edat gerekmez.
items.en: "naik" + vehicle means "take/ride [vehicle]" — no preposition needed, unlike English "by bus".
items.context: Saya naik ojek ke kantor. / ✗ Saya naik dengan ojek ke kantor.

items.en: You need to find a bus.
items.context: Halte bus terdekat di mana, ya?

items.en: You're running late and need a ride now.
You're on the bus, unsure where to get off.
items.context: Turun di mana, ya, biar deket stasiun?

items.en: You're not sure of the route.
items.context: Ini kereta berhenti di bandara, nggak?
Saya lebih suka jalan kaki aja.

items.target: Halte bus terdekat di mana, ya?

items.en: I take a motorbike taxi to the office.
I'll just book a ride-hailing motorbike.

items.target: Turun di mana, ya, biar deket stasiun?
items.en: Where should I get off to be close to the station?

items.target: Ini kereta berhenti di bandara, nggak?
items.en: Does this train stop at the airport?
How long does the trip take?

items.target: Saya lebih suka jalan kaki aja.

items.tr: Acil yardım isterken cümle "Tolong" ile başlar ve fiil özne olmadan buyurma kipinde kullanılır.
items.en: Urgent requests start with "Tolong" (please/help), followed by the bare verb with no subject.
items.context: Tolong panggil ambulans! / ✗ Kamu tolong panggil ambulans!

items.en: You don't know where you are.
I'm lost, can you help me?

items.tr: "Mandi" (duş almak) gibi günlük rutin fiilleri tek başına kullanılır, İngilizce'deki gibi bir nesne ya da "kendini" almaz.
items.en: Everyday routine verbs like "mandi" (to shower) stand alone — no object or reflexive pronoun needed, unlike English "take a shower".
items.context: Dia mandi tiap pagi. / ✗ Dia mandi dirinya tiap pagi.

items.en: You talk about your family's mornings.

items.context: Saya selalu gosok gigi dua kali sehari.

items.en: I usually wake up at seven.
He goes to the office by motorbike.

items.target: Saya selalu gosok gigi dua kali sehari.
items.tr: Her zaman günde iki kez dişlerimi fırçalarım.
items.en: I always brush my teeth twice a day.
They usually go to bed late.

items.tr: Geçmiş zaman fiil değişimiyle değil, "kemarin" (dün) gibi zaman belirteçleriyle gösterilir.
items.en: Past time is shown with time words like "kemarin" (yesterday), not by changing the verb.
items.context: Kemarin saya pergi ke pasar. / ✗ Kemarin saya pergilah ke pasar.

items.en: You're telling a friend about your day.

items.context: Dompet saya hilang di jalan pulang.

items.en: Yesterday I went to the market.
Then I ran into an old friend.
We chatted for about an hour.

items.target: Dompet saya hilang di jalan pulang.
items.en: I lost my wallet on the way home.
Ask for the next place or step.
Excuse me, where is the station?
Say what you did not understand.
Describe what you are looking for.
Ask about the cost or condition.
I am looking for a flat.

items.target: Sebelum matahari panas, saya menyapu halaman.
Setelah itu, saya mencuci piring di dapur.
Suami saya menyiram tanaman di belakang rumah.
items.tr: Kocam arka bahçedeki bitkilere su verir.
Ev her zaman düzenli ve temiz.

items.target: Sabtu depan ada konser di teater.
Saya dan sahabatku membeli dua tiket.
items.tr: Ben ve en yakın arkadaşım iki bilet aldık.

items.target: Kami akan datang lebih awal dan duduk di baris depan.
Saya tidak menari, saya hanya mendengarkan.
Kami memasak makan malam besar bersama.
items.tr: Birlikte büyük bir akşam yemeği pişiriyoruz.

items.target: Adikku meniup lilin di kue, lalu kami minum jus.
items.tr: Kardeşim pastadaki mumları üflüyor, sonra meyve suyu içiyoruz.
